title: Hepatotoxic Components Effect of Chebulae Fructus and Associated Molecular Mechanism by Integrated Transcriptome and Molecular Docking.
authors: Ai, Liwen; Yang, Fan; Hu, Wanjun; Guo, Liyang; Liu, Weixue; Xue, Xuexue; Li, Lulu; Sheng, Zunlai
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组和分子对接研究使君子致肝毒性成分与PPARα/FABP蛋白的结合，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法仅常规对接，与TF-DNA课题关联弱。
abstract: Chebulae Fructus (CF) is a natural medicinal plant widely used for its various pharmacological properties. Natural products used to cure several diseases have been considered safe thanks to their little or no side effects. However, in recent years, a hepatotoxic effect has been found due to the abuse of herbal medicine. CF has been reported to have hepatotoxicity, but the mechanism is unclear. In this experiment, the toxic aspect and mechanism of CF action were evaluated by transcriptome analysis. Components of toxic CF fractions were identified by LC-MS, and hepatotoxic toxic components in toxic CF fractions were predicted by molecular docking. The results showed that the ethyl acetate part of CF was the main toxic fraction, and transcriptome analysis found that the toxic mechanism was highly related to lipid metabolism-related pathways, and CFEA could inhibit the PPAR signaling pathway. Molecular docking results showed that 3'-O-methyl-4-O-(n''-O-galloyl-beta-d-xylopyranosyl) ellagic acid (n = 2, 3 or 4) and 4-O-(3'',4''-O-digalloyl-alpha-l-rhamnosyl) ellagic acid have better docking energies with PPARalpha protein and FABP protein than other components. In summary, 3'-O-methyl-4-O-(n''-O-galloyl-beta-d-xylopyranosyl) ellagic acid (n = 2, 3 or 4) and 4-O-(3'',4''-O-digalloyl-alpha-l-rhamnosyl) ellagic acid were the main toxic components, which may play a toxic role by inhibiting the PPAR signaling pathway and affect lipid metabolism.
abstract_zh: 诃子（Chebulae Fructus, CF）是一种天然药用植物，因其多种药理性质而被广泛使用。用于治疗多种疾病的天然产物因其极少或无副作用而被认为是安全的。然而，近年来，由于草药滥用，已发现肝毒性效应。已有报道指出CF具有肝毒性，但其机制尚不清楚。本实验中，通过转录组分析评估了CF作用的毒性方面及其机制。通过LC-MS鉴定了CF毒性部位的成分，并通过分子对接预测了CF毒性部位中的肝毒性成分。结果表明，CF的乙酸乙酯部分为主要毒性部位，转录组分析发现其毒性机制与脂质代谢相关通路高度相关，且CFEA能抑制PPAR信号通路。分子对接结果显示，3'-O-甲基-4-O-(n''-O-没食子酰基-β-D-吡喃木糖基)鞣花酸（n=2、3或4）和4-O-(3'',4''-O-二没食子酰基-α-L-鼠李糖基)鞣花酸与PPARα蛋白和FABP蛋白的对接能优于其他成分。总之，3'-O-甲基-4-O-(n''-O-没食子酰基-β-D-吡喃木糖基)鞣花酸（n=2、3或4）和4-O-(3'',4''-O-二没食子酰基-α-L-鼠李糖基)鞣花酸是主要毒性成分，可能通过抑制PPAR信号通路发挥毒性作用，并影响脂质代谢。
